parameters.content:
Lantern Pantry — Market Plan for Monday, Oct 12

Objectives
- Open with clear posted prices; be ready to haggle but protect margins. Primary goal: sell through slow-moving stock (soy sauce, miso, soap) while keeping enough cash for entry fee and emergencies.

Cash management
- Entry fee: $20 will be paid before opening. Maintain a $20 cash reserve at all times for next entry fee. Avoid supplier orders that drop cash below $25.

Pricing & negotiation rules
- Posted prices are set; be flexible within ~15–25% for quick sales depending on customer. Default minimum acceptable: cost + 10% (rounded) unless customer buys multiple items.
- For bundles, offer small discounts rather than big single-item markdowns to preserve margins.

Promotions (for the day)
- Bundle: Buy 2 Short-grain Rice (2kg) for $16 (posted $9 each, bundle saves $2) and include one Lacquered Chopstick Set free if customer asks for a bonus (stock permitting).
- BOGO-lite: Buy one Soy Sauce at posted price, get Handsmade Yuzu Soap for $3 (posted $5) if customer bundles—encourages cross-sell.

Stock focus & service
- Highlight rice, soy sauce, and miso as pantry staples. Use samples of yuzu soap as a giveaway to start conversations.
- Keep chopsticks visible near rice for easy bundle upsell.

Restock triggers & supplier plan
- If rice <=6 units at day's end, order 6 more rice from Hayashi Supply (wholesale $4 each).
- If soy_sauce <=4 units, order 6 soy_sauce (wholesale $2 each).
- No supplier orders placed now; observe Monday demand first to avoid overcommitment.

Notes
- Be ready to accept small-counter offers to build repeat customers. Track each customer’s purchase pattern in ledger for follow-up.
- If a customer asks for something we don’t have, offer to source it from Hayashi Supply after market close and quote a realistic lead time (arrives in two days).
